agent_explanation: Controller computes force as kp * velocity-error but fails to saturate at fmax. At step 59 force is exactly at the limit (59.983). At step 60 bodies 0 and 1 collide (touching_pairs gap 0.00034) impulsively changing body 0 velocity (vy -0.27 to -2.40), increasing velocity error vs waypoint command, so raw kp*error jumps to 163.22 exceeding fmax 59.983. Lowering kp removes the exceedance, confirming unsaturated proportional law as cause.
